use_case: A university research lab's experiment log: researchers, protocols, experiments, measurements and the published papers they fed.
organization_name: Kessler Lab for Applied Microbial Ecology

protocols.name: Soil Sample DNA Extraction v3
protocols.summary: Bead-beating lysis followed by silica-column purification, tuned for high-humic-acid soils that otherwise inhibit downstream PCR. Includes a secondary wash step added after v2 showed inconsistent 260/230 ratios.

protocols.name: 16S rRNA Amplicon Sequencing Prep
protocols.summary: Two-step PCR targeting the V4 region with dual-index barcoding, pooled and normalized before submission to the sequencing core.

protocols.name: Anaerobic Chamber Culturing
protocols.summary: Standard operating procedure for maintaining the Coy chamber's atmosphere and streaking anaerobic isolates without oxygen exposure exceeding thirty seconds.

protocols.name: Metagenome Shotgun Library Prep
protocols.summary: Tagmentation-based library prep for shotgun metagenomics, with a size-selection step to exclude fragments under 300bp.

protocols.name: qPCR Gene Copy Quantification
protocols.summary: Standard curve method for absolute quantification of functional gene copies, run in technical triplicate against a plasmid standard.

protocols.name: Field Sampling: Riparian Transect
protocols.summary: Sampling procedure for the creek-side transect sites, including GPS logging, depth-stratified cores, and cold-chain handling to the lab within four hours.

experiments.title: Nitrogen amendment effect on riparian soil microbial diversity
experiments.hypothesis: Elevated nitrogen loading from adjacent agricultural runoff reduces alpha diversity in riparian soil communities relative to unamended control plots.
experiments.notes: Diversity dropped as predicted at the two highest-nitrogen sites but not at the moderate site; writing this up as a threshold effect rather than a linear one.

experiments.title: Anaerobic isolate screening for novel sulfate reducers
experiments.hypothesis: Sediment from the low-oxygen creek bend harbors sulfate-reducing taxa not represented in the lab's existing isolate collection.
experiments.notes: Two isolates show 16S identity below 97% to anything in the reference database; sent for whole-genome sequencing.

experiments.title: Seasonal variation in functional gene abundance (nifH)
experiments.hypothesis: nifH gene copy number, a proxy for nitrogen-fixing capacity, peaks in late summer when soil temperature and moisture jointly favor diazotroph activity.
experiments.notes: Six of eight monthly timepoints collected; August sample delayed two weeks by a broken cold-chain cooler.

experiments.title: Metagenomic comparison of amended vs. control plots
experiments.hypothesis: Functional gene content, not just taxonomic composition, shifts under nitrogen amendment, particularly in denitrification pathway genes.
experiments.notes: Sequencing complete; assembly and binning running on the cluster, ETA two more weeks.

experiments.title: Comparative extraction efficiency across soil types
experiments.hypothesis: The v3 extraction protocol yields comparable DNA quality across clay-heavy, sandy, and loam soils from the three field sites.
experiments.notes: Clay soils still underperform on 260/230 ratio despite the v3 wash step; flagged for a v4 revision.

experiments.title: Pilot: eDNA detection of an invasive crayfish species
experiments.hypothesis: Water samples from three creek sites contain detectable environmental DNA from the invasive crayfish reported upstream last year.
experiments.notes: Positive detection at two of three sites; results shared with the county watershed office ahead of publication.

experiments.title: Undergraduate thesis: compost pile succession over 90 days
experiments.hypothesis: Microbial community composition in a managed compost pile follows a predictable thermophilic-to-mesophilic succession independent of starting feedstock.
experiments.notes: Succession pattern matched literature closely; good candidate for an undergraduate research symposium poster.

experiments.title: Cross-site validation of the nifH qPCR assay
experiments.hypothesis: The lab's nifH assay, validated on local soils, produces consistent standard curves when run on soil from his home institution's field sites.
experiments.notes: Standard curves matched within acceptable variance; assay judged transferable between labs.

experiments.title: Denitrification gene expression under flooding
experiments.hypothesis: Simulated flooding upregulates denitrification gene expression within 48 hours in riparian soil mesocosms.
experiments.notes: Mesocosms flooded on schedule; RNA extraction for the 24h timepoint underway.

experiments.title: Retest: extraction kit lot-to-lot variability
experiments.hypothesis: Two different lots of the silica-column kit produce statistically indistinguishable yield and purity from the same homogenized soil sample.
experiments.notes: No significant difference found; kit lot ruled out as a variable in the March anomaly.

experiments.title: Sulfate reducer isolate genome annotation
experiments.hypothesis: The two novel isolates from the 2026 screening carry a complete dsrAB gene cluster confirming their sulfate-reducing phenotype.
experiments.notes: Both genomes carry complete dsrAB clusters; manuscript in preparation with Dr. Kessler.

experiments.title: Field method comparison: corer depth stratification
experiments.hypothesis: Microbial community composition differs significantly between the 0-5cm and 5-15cm depth strata at the same sampling point.
experiments.notes: Strong depth effect confirmed; all future transect sampling will keep strata separate rather than pooling.

experiments.title: Pilot: portable sequencer field trial
experiments.hypothesis: A portable nanopore sequencer run in a field tent can produce usable taxonomic classification within six hours of sample collection.
experiments.notes: Humidity inside the field tent caused the flow cell to fail after two hours; postponed until a climate-controlled enclosure is available.

experiments.title: Compost thermophile isolate collection
experiments.hypothesis: Thermophilic isolates from the day-14 compost timepoint remain culturable after cryopreservation for downstream physiological testing.
experiments.notes: Four of six isolates recovered successfully after freezing; added to the lab's permanent collection.

experiments.title: Winter baseline resampling of the three field sites
experiments.hypothesis: Winter baseline community composition at the three sites is stable year over year, justifying a single annual baseline sample going forward.
experiments.notes: Scheduled for the next cold snap; equipment reserved.
